resumen: Reserva: lunes 21 de septiembre a las 8:00, Dr. Marc Puig, Arenal Norte

eventos.texto: Good afternoon, Clínica Arenal, you're through to reception. How can I help you today?
Línea reconocida: hay una ficha con ese teléfono
Hello, I'm calling for my son. He needs to see the pediatrician, the earliest you have.
Entiende cuándo la quiere: lo antes posible
Falta el nombre para buscar la ficha
And who is the appointment for? Their full name and date of birth, please.
His name is Paul Vidal Serra, born 10th of April 2019.
Ficha encontrada: Pau V. (por fecha de nacimiento y nombre)
Ofrece el lunes 21 de septiembre a las 8:00 con el Dr. Marc Puig en Arenal Norte
Thank you, I have Pau's record here. The earliest I have in the morning is Monday the 21st of September at 8 am with Dr. Marc Puig at Arenal Norte. Shall I book that for you?
Reserva · lunes 21 de septiembre, 8:00 · Dr. Marc Puig · Arenal Norte
That's booked: Monday the 21st of September at 8 am with Dr. Marc Puig at Arenal Norte. Is there anything else I can help with?
Thank you for calling. Take care, goodbye.
